evals.prompt: Create a dwarven blacksmith named Gunnar Stonejaw in Stoneforge, Ironpeak Mountains. Gruff but fair.

assertions.check: Private file has YAML with type: NPC, name, location, region, profession, race, status
Private tags include NPC, IronpeakMountains, Stoneforge
Private file embeds public file with ![[Public/World/Ironpeak Mountains/Stoneforge/NPCs/Gunnar Stonejaw]]
Private has Personality section with Ideal, Bond, Flaw, Quirk
Private does NOT duplicate Description content that belongs in the public file embed
Private dataview uses FROM [[]] not FROM [[#this.file.name]]
Public has Appearance, What We Know, First Impressions, Interactions sections

evals.prompt: Create a friendly merchant named Lyra Goldthread in Highreach, Crestfall. She's secretly feeding information to the Nightstalkers.

assertions.check: Private file has Secrets section mentioning Nightstalkers connection
Public file describes her as a merchant — no spy hint
Private Links section includes [[Nightstalkers]] or full path
Cascading creation asks about creating her shop if none exists
